Discrimination
Apr 2026 • Family
The restaurant is very popular among travelers, but it turns out they only welcome well-known or returning guests, showing clear discrimination toward new visitors. There’s no option to choose a window-side table when I reserved. I made an early reservation specifically to get a spot with a nice view, but the restaurant messaged me saying, “We’re sorry, the window-side tables are fully booked as they’ve already been reserved. "??. It turned out there was no window-view table available for us because they were all reserved, which didn’t make any sense to me. Just save a great table for your favorite guests. I won’t be coming back to this restaurant. I don’t eat for free. Thanks for taking the time to read this.

More Than Expected, Outstanding Team and Service
Nov 2025 • Business
I organised a gala dinner for 30 guests at Oriental Pearl at the end of November 2025. As always, the service was excellent. I have worked with Oriental Pearl several times and have consistently received outstanding support from their staff.

In 2024, I booked tables in advance for a special company event. Despite a system error that resulted in a duplicate booking, the director promptly upgraded our event to a private room on the 69th floor with a customised buffet layout, while maintaining the same price as our original deal. The event went smoothly and all our guests were delighted. My sincere thanks to Khả Tú for the excellent organisation, as well as to Phương Trang and Tấn Đạt for beautifully coordinating the food and ensuring everything was always available.

For our most recent 2025 event, I am also grateful to Mocha for her timely support and assistance throughout the evening at Oriental Pearl.

Thank you all for making our events both memorable and successful!
